title: Plow Codex traces
description: Explore redacted Codex OTLP spans recorded by Tempo. Missing results can reflect partial instrumented coverage or an inactive ingest route.

list.name: spanStatus
list.label: Span status
list.description: Show traces containing at least one span with this OTLP status. Unset is a recorded span status.
list.query: Any : true, Error : span:status = error, OK : span:status = ok, Unset : span:status = unset

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Up to 20 traces in the UTC range. Open a Trace ID for the span tree, waterfall and retained span attributes. Trace times come from the Codex exporter. An empty result can reflect missing instrumentation, an inactive route, or restrictive filters. Try a wider range or Any span status.

targets.query: { instrumentation:name = "plow.codex" && (${spanStatus:raw}) } | select(span:status, span.conversation.id, span.turn.id, span.call_id) with (most_recent=true)
